tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows marked leukocytosis and elevated hematocrit, which may indicate infection, inflammation, or possible myeloproliferative disorder. Platelet distribution width is also significantly increased, suggesting platelet activation or heterogeneity. Other red cell and platelet parameters are within normal limits. Correlation with clinical findings and further diagnostic workup is recommended.
